item.title: 【Off-Topic】Decoding binary data from QR codes fails
item.description:
Hi. I'm interested in data encoding and decoding.

I wanna eventually use YouTube as file storage,
even if decoding is slow asf.

My idea: Store binary chunks of data (base64 encoded) in QR codes -- and that will work.

I've made a script to encode files and to decode files;
I used Gemini AI for this.

You need to prepare yourself for a lot of data-garbage.
Because a 547 MB file wound up as a 12 GB YouTube video.
(The version downloaded from YouTube)

And decoding that back to individual frames (png) created 321 GB of frame files.

And the most annoying part of all: The decoded file from those 321 GB of frames was invalid
(because a few images (QR) could not be converted back to binary format with the script I have.)

Here's what happend:
I tested the proposed scripts but during the decoding with pyzbar it doesn't always work as expected.
I get warnings and a faulty output file. There are gaps in the file.
Some binary fragments are lost during the process which is annoying.
